paper.title: ArchR is a scalable software package for integrative single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis
paper.baseline: The tutorial subset spans hematopoietic progenitors and differentiated blood cells; accessibility, gene activity, motif evidence and trajectories resolve B-cell and myeloid differentiation programs.

minimumEvidence: QC includes fragment depth, TSS enrichment and doublet handling
embedding is checked against sample source and technical covariates
candidate biological labels use gene activity plus peak or motif evidence
strong regulatory claims include an explicit alternative explanation and validation plan

requiredResults: cell embedding with sample and biological interpretation
